single_variable: Choose the lifetime of the original 2/3 resting 2R target before entry according to how dispersed the eligible asset returns were in the 12H bar preceding the key candle. Dispersion is the 75th minus 25th percentile of the 12H log return among contracts having 90 contiguous days, minimum ten names. If dispersion strictly exceeds the median of its preceding 20 completed observations (the existing fast EMA length), cancel the target after twelve hours to allow more tail growth. Otherwise, including missing information, leave the target in place. No fitted cutoff or timing search.
comparison: Three identical-holding-roster unlevered OKX accounts: always expire (frozen results), always leave the target in place, and disperse-market expiry only. 1000U, nine shared slots, original stop/EMA, 20% marked single-contract cap, market 5bp, maker 2bp, before funding and impact. Cross-venue and time-matched controls are warranted if the conditional arm improves development terminal wealth over the always-rest parent and meets the 30% wins, payoff and 35% conservative drawdown objectives on both development and full history. Shared history has been explored before.
